title: [finding] check-error-status-conformance's walk() stats every readdir entry unguarded, so a tsup temp config deleted mid-walk takes the whole run down with ENOENT — on a file the next line would have discarded anyway
body:
⛔ Filed unassigned, ⛔ no `priority:*`, ⛔ no `domain:*`, ⛔ no type — routing and grading are triage's. Routing suggestion: **`domain:spec`** (gate tooling around the spec contract). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution **seat 1** (`session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`, seat post #6017), 2026-09-22T05:3xZ, from a CI failure observed on an unrelated docs-only PR.

**Class (a)** — the defect is visible in the source and one instance is observed in CI. ⚠️ It is a **race**, so it is ⛔ not deterministically reproducible on demand; the code reading below is what carries it, ⛔ not a probe.

## The defect

`scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs`, the `walk()` under 「The real check」:

```js
function walk(dir, out) {
  for (const e of readdirSync(dir)) {
    if (SKIP_DIRS.has(e)) continue;
    const p = join(dir, e);
    const s = statSync(p);          // ← unguarded
    if (s.isDirectory()) walk(p, out);
    else if (/\.tsx?$/.test(e) && !/\.(test|spec|d)\.tsx?$/.test(e)) out.push(p);
  }
}
```

`readdirSync` snapshots the directory; `statSync` runs later. Any entry deleted in between throws **ENOENT** and takes the whole run down.

## Observed instance

`Test Core (1/6)` on PR #19659, head `5ac6291a99c4`, job `106625053057`:

> `::error file=scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs, title=[repo] src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts, line=1802` — `Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat 'packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_mz2es9op0s7.mjs'`
> `❯ walk :1802 ❯ scanSources :1817 ❯ deriveWireFace :1862 ❯ src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts:55`

⭐ **`Tests 580 passed (580)`** — ⛔ **no assertion failed.** The file died during collection, so the suite reports a failure with nothing wrong in what it was testing.

## ⭐ Three readings that make this a defect rather than weather

1. **The repo already declares this file class transient.** `.gitignore:94` is `*.bundled_*.mjs`. `tsup.config.bundled_<hash>.mjs` is the temp config tsup writes and deletes around a bundle ⇒ a concurrent package build in the same workspace is enough, and the monorepo runs builds and tests together.
2. ⭐⭐ **The entry would have been THROWN AWAY anyway.** The filter one line down keeps only `/\.tsx?$/`. A `.mjs` can never reach `out`. ⇒ the walk crashes on a file it did not want, so guarding it loses **exactly zero** information — there is no correctness argument on the other side.
3. **The guard exists in this very file and is not used here.** `:156` imports `existsSync`; the only use is `:1907` for the baseline. ⛔ Not an unavailable API — an unreached one.

## Blast radius — ⚠️ it is not this gate's own PRs

Any PR whose CI happens to overlap a tsup bundle in the workspace can eat this, **whatever it changed**. The observed instance is a **docs-only** PR — two files, `packages/spec/liveness/README.md` and a changeset — which cannot touch this code path at all. ⇒ it charges unrelated PRs a red run and a landing cycle.

## ⚠️ What this card does NOT claim

- ⛔ **Not** proposed as a new gate, a new check, or a strength change — it asks an existing walk to survive a file vanishing. ⛔ Nothing about the conformance verdict moves.
- ⛔ **Not** a flaky-ledger entry. 「疑似新 flaky 只留提请,⛔ 不自行加表」 — this is the 提请, and only a human upgrades the ledger.
- ⚠️ ⛔ **Not re-run to confirm.** This seat holds no `actions: write` — `POST /actions/jobs/{id}/rerun` and `/runs/{id}/rerun-failed-jobs` both answer **403**. So 「reproduces identically on one re-run」 is **NOT MEASURED**, and this card ⛔ does not claim it.
